summary: First draft of ADR-010: the person draws in the Excalidraw editor, which saves the canonical .excalidraw scene (the store); @aof/diagrams' scene-view projects it into the Mermaid view, in the mermaid-profile grammar; the architect reads that view as context and proposes an edited view as a review record, which the editor previews and accepts.
rationale: No diagram brief exists, so the draft follows ADR-010's Decision: one store (the scene, which the architect never sees), one pure projection shared by server and editor (scene-view, speaking the mermaid-profile), and the architect's whole interface being the Mermaid view (context in, edited view out as a proposal). The two pure modules are grouped because ADR-010 names them as one package's loaded-by-both seam. No library items fit (the project's library is AWS icons). The scene node uses Mermaid's cylinder bracket, which the profile draws as a box. No ADR amendment is implied.
